entities.summary: Mohamed Zaoui is a former middleweight boxer from Algeria. He won the bronze medal at the 1984 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles, becoming the first Algerian to ever win a medal at the Olympic Games. Mohamed Zaoui was a athletes & competitors from Nedroma (b. 1960-05-14, Nedroma). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
